name: ninjaone
description: NinjaOne RMM: fleet health, devices, patching, alerts, reports, ticketing and documentation through the NinjaOne Public API v2. Read-only by default.

interface.shortDescription: Safe, complete access to the NinjaOne RMM API
interface.longDescription: Ask about every client's fleet health, triage a device, review patch failures, search alerts and tickets, and run gated actions. Read-only until you turn writes on; destructive actions need a second switch.
defaultPrompt: Use NinjaOne to show fleet health across every client.
Use NinjaOne to list offline servers and why they need attention.
Use NinjaOne to summarize failed patches this week.
